items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Syl bought it off a Mexican guy and it was called something else.

ctx.x: Before Syl had the saloon and named it the Kansas City, because Syl bought it off a Mexican guy and it was called something else. And he named it the Kansas City Bar because he said he was from Kansas City. Yeah.
Remember the other pieces that Jelly played?
